data._ASK_FOR_CODE_MODULE: Ask for a code created through the code module
data._ASK_FOR_DROPDOWN_TREE_CODE: Ask for a tree code chosen by the user from a list in a dropdown menu
data._ASK_FOR_MANUAL_TREE_CODE: Ask for a tree code that must be entered manually by the user
data._ASK_FOR_TREE_COURSE_CODE: Ask for a code from the course tree
data._CONFERENCE_CREATION_LIMIT_PER_USER: Limit for the number of conferences that can be planned by a single user
data._CONFIRM_REGISTER_TYPE_SELF: ATTENTION: without double opt-in user's email won't be checked. You may be subject to spam registrations.
data._COURSE_QUOTA: Limit for the maximum total size of contents uploaded into the course (MB)
data._CURRENCY_SYMBOL: Currency symbol (will be displayed at user side)
data._EXCLUDE_COMPLETED_COURSES: Exclude completed course from the view "All open"
data._FIRST_CATALOGUE: Show "course catalog" as user main page
data._FORUM_AS_TABLE: Show forum list in a table
data._HOUR_REQUEST_LIMIT: Limit, in hours, for the expiration of the subscription request
data._HTMLEDIT_IMAGE_ADMIN: Allow administrator media management in the editor
data._HTMLEDIT_IMAGE_GODADMIN: Allow super-administrator media management in the editor
data._HTMLEDIT_IMAGE_USER: Allow user media management in the editor
data._KB_FILTER_BY_USER_ACCESS: In the result area of the content library searches, show also objects not directly available to the user
data._KB_SHOW_UNCATEGORIZED: In the result area of the content library searches, show also objects that aren't fully categorized
data._LASTFIRST_MANDATORY: First Name and Last Name are required in order to register
data._LDAP_USER_STRING:
Username for LDAP users, use $user for the username.
Ex. $user@domain2.domain1 (for: W2k3)
data._MAIL_SENDER: Registrations and Lost passwords email sender
data._MAIL_SENDER_NAME_FROM: Sender name of registration emails and automatic password recovery procedure
data._MANDATORY_CODE: If one of the registration code options above are enabled, users are forced to enter the registration code (the code field must be filled in)
data._MAX_LOG_ATTEMPT: Maximum number of consecutively failed login attempts (0 = no limit)
data._NL_SENDPERCYCLE: Send newsletter messages in blocks of
data._NO_ANSWER_IN_POLL: Use "no answer" option in poll questions
data._NO_ANSWER_IN_TEST: Use "no answer" option in test questions
data._NOTSCORM: With domxml OFF, the SCORM module, language management and videoconferencing will not work
data._ON_CATALOGUE_EMPTY: If not a single course catalog is assigned to a user, show all the courses and curricula
data._ON_PATH_IN_MYCOURSES: Show learning courses belonging to learning path in "My courses tab"
data._ON_USERCOURSE_EMPTY: Send user to catalog if not enrolled in any course
data._ORGCHART_SINGLENODE: Limit the user to only one node of the organization chart
data._PAGE_TITLE: Page title (will appear in the user's browser)
data._PASS_ALFANUMERIC: Password must be composed of letters and numbers
data._PASS_CHANGE_FIRST_LOGIN: Force users to change their password at the first login
data._PASS_MAX_TIME_VALID: Password validity, max number of days the password will be valid (0 for unlimited)
data._PASS_MIN_CHAR: Password length, minimum number of characters
data._PASS_MIN_DIGIT:
Minimum number of digit characters
( 0 = digit characters not mandatory )
data._PASS_MIN_LOWERCASE:
Minimum number of lowercase characters
( 0 = lowercase characters not mandatory )
data._PASS_MIN_UPPERCASE:
Minimum number of uppercase characters
( 0 = uppercase characters not mandatory)
data._PASS_SEND_REMIND:
Send an email one day before password expiration
(enable cron job)
data._PASS_SPECIAL_CHAR:
Minimum number of special characters
( 0 = special characters not mandatory )
data._PATHCHAT: Save Path for the files uploaded in the chat shared files
data._PATHCOURSE: Save Path for the files uploaded in the course info
data._PATHFORUM: Save Path for the files uploaded as forum attachment
data._PATHLESSON: Save Path for the files uploaded in the upload files
data._PATHMESSAGE: Save Path for files uploaded as message attachments
data._PATHPRJ: Save Path for files uploaded in project manager
data._PATHSCORM: Save Path for files uploaded as SCORM Learning Object
data._PAYPAL_SANDBOX: Use PayPal sandbox instead of the real environment (this is a debug and testing option)
data._PLUGIN_ERROR_CORE_DEACTIVATE: Plugin cannot be deactivated because it belongs to core
data._PLUGIN_ERROR_CORE_UNINSTALL: Plugin cannot be uninstalled because it belongs to core
data._PLUGIN_ERROR_DEACTIVATE_DEPENDENCE: Plugin cannot be deactivated because of dependent plugins
data._PLUGIN_ERROR_NO_DEPENDENCIES: Plugin cannot be installed because of missing dependencies
data._PLUGIN_ERROR_NOT_ONLINE_UPDATE: Plugin update online is not available
data._PLUGIN_ERROR_OLD_VERSION: Plugin files version does not match with forma.lms
data._PLUGIN_ERROR_UNINSTALL_DEPENDENCE: Plugin cannot be uninstalled because of dependent plugins
data._PROFILE_ONLY_PWD: Limit user to change just his password (deactivate extended profile)
data._REGISTER_DELETED_USER: Keep a record of all the deleted users
data._REQUEST_MANDATORY_FIELDS_COMPILATION: At the login the user is prompted to fill in the mandatory fields related to his profile
data._REST_AUTH_UPDATE: Refresh token lifetime at every API call
data._SAVE_LA_AFTER_MAX: Yes, only if the max number is reached
data._SAVE_LOG_ATTEMPT: Save info about failed login attempts
data._SCO_DIRECT_PLAY: Allow the usage of direct links from external sources to SCORM chapters (sco and asset)
data._SEND_CC_FOR_SYSTEM_EMAILS: Add the following address as CC for all the email sent by the platform
data._SEND_CCN_FOR_SYSTEM_EMAILS: Add the following address as CCN for all the email sent by the platform
data._SENDER_EVENT: Sender email address for alert messages
data._SESSION_IP_CONTROL: Enable IP control within sessions (user can't change IP after login)
data._SMS_CREDIT_UPDATE: Credit will be updated when you will send a further SMS.
data._SOCIAL_FB_ACTIVE: Use Facebook interfacing and Single Sign On
data._SOCIAL_GOOGLE_ACTIVE:
Use Google interfacing and Single Sign On
(use redirect uri: http://server/path/index.php?modname=login&op=google_login)
data._SOCIAL_LINKEDIN_ACTIVE: Use Linkedin interfacing and Single Sign On
data._SOCIAL_TWITTER_ACTIVE: Use Twitter interfacing and Single Sign On
data._SSO_SECRET: <abbr title="Single Sign On">SSO</abbr> secret for the token hash
data._SSO_TOKEN: Enable <abbr title="Single Sign On">SSO</abbr> with a third party software through a token
data._STOP_CONCURRENT_USER: Disable simultaneous access with the same username
data._USE_DIMDIM_API: Use DimDim API instead of URL interfacing
data._USE_IMMEDIATE_REPORT: Create report and send it by email as soon as it is ready (report execution must be enabled in crontab)
data._USE_SENDER_ACLNAME: Sender name from for alert messages
data._USEFULL_ONLY_IF: Consider this parameter only if you need to authenticate through LDAP
data._USER_PWD_HISTORY_LENGTH: Ask the user to choose a password different from the last X used passwords
data._USER_QUOTA: Disk quota (in MB) for each user's My Files area
data._WARINNG_SOCIAL: Attention without these settings the social login will not work
